ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut. Gate spot-checked: internal/wire/server.go:154-179 — accept() never reads a peer's hello inline; each accepted conn draws a slot from s.pendingSlots (:165-170, over-capacity closed outright) and runs startConnection in its own goroutine. startConnection (:205-260) orders hello read and trust.Verify strictly before lane-capacity acquisition, preserving the record's 'do not move capacity earlier' constraint. AdoptHandoff (:185-203) walks the same bounded gate.
